answer: Trust the check, not the claimant: Registered loom builder frame file with loom builders confirmation is the check, and it reads 1-year training, 392 supervised buildings, science exam, annual renewal. One honest agent clears the check in 16 minutes; a farm of 679 pays 10864 minutes every single epoch. The kernel is stamped by a stranger, the cipher is counted by a ledger, and the lagoon is filed by a clerk with no stake in it. Everything above is checkable from public records; nothing here rests on trust.
